column5: Slow cinematic aerial dolly-in at golden sunrise over the Subramaniya Swamy Temple at Tiruchendur, Tamil Nadu — a towering nine-tiered white-and-ochre Dravidian gopuram with gold finials standing directly on the Bay of Bengal shoreline. Gentle surf rolls onto pale sand at the temple's stone perimeter wall, warm dawn light catching the carved tiers, a few gulls drifting past, palm fronds swaying at the frame edge. The camera glides forward and slightly downward toward the gopuram as waves break softly in the foreground. Photorealistic travel-documentary drone footage, soft volumetric morning haze, natural color grade.

Strings of weathered prayer flags flutter on stone cairns along the rocky shoreline in the foreground, thin mist sliding off scree slopes, alpenglow turning the summit ice pale gold against a deep blue high-altitude sky. The camera glides slowly over the water toward the reflected peak. Photorealistic high-altitude travel footage, crisp thin-air clarity, natural color grade.

column5: Cinematic aerial orbit above Devprayag, Uttarakhand in soft morning light — the exact two-toned river confluence where the jade-green Bhagirathi meets the silt-grey Alaknanda in a sharp V to form the Ganges. A triangular stone bathing ghat juts into the meeting point of the two water colors, whitewashed and pastel houses of the old town stacked up the steep forested ridge above, mist threading through the Garhwal hills behind. The camera arcs slowly around the confluence point as the two distinct water colors swirl together downstream. Photorealistic drone travel footage, natural color grade.
